invariants.rationale: The method accesses intervals.length and intervals[i], so intervals must not be null.
The method throws if this is not true, so it's guaranteed upon method exit.
The method assigns this.animationIntervals = intervals when intervals.length matches animationIntervals.length.
loopDuration is initialized to 0 and only incremented by intervals[i], which are ints, so it cannot decrease.
If there are no intervals, the only possible loopDuration is 0 (though probably intervals.length>0 at this point).
